defect.summary: The canonical required field tts_runtime_binary_sha256 is currently populated with sha256(sys.executable), while the independently computed piper-tts distribution manifest digest is not required by REQUIRED_NAMES/validate_required. The Python interpreter does not uniquely identify the Piper runtime that generated the bound waveform.

minimal_repair: Bind the canonical TTS runtime identity to the exact Piper runtime/distribution artifact actually used for synthesis; do not substitute Python interpreter identity.
Require that Piper runtime identity in canonical terminal validation and bind it causally to the exact source waveform/TTS lineage before playback.
Record Python interpreter SHA256 separately only as auxiliary interpreter identity if useful.
Fail closed when the Piper runtime/distribution artifact cannot be deterministically resolved.
Preserve existing model/config/waveform hashes, packet lineage, PipeWire identities, H4 coverage guard, cancellation delivery, cleanup and all zero-credit fences.
required_regressions: Same Python interpreter with two different Piper distribution manifests must produce distinct canonical TTS runtime identity.
Missing Piper runtime/distribution identity with present interpreter hash must make canonical_required_observables_guard.complete false.
Changed Piper runtime with unchanged interpreter/model must change canonical TTS runtime identity.
A correctly bound Piper runtime identity must retain all current G2 zero-credit fences.
execution_order: Refresh main and current semantic/runtime singleton ownership before mutation.
Apply only the smallest existing-guard repair; do not create a second evidence or Voice authority.
Run focused repository regressions for the repaired runtime identity contract.
Only after source/regression closure and clear singleton ownership, dispatch exactly one fresh current S2 G2 subject against the repaired exact SHA.
Do not compose older S2 runtime evidence with repaired source into current terminal credit.
Do not open G3, FDX12, partial-ASR or long-session breadth until G2 is terminal.
next_exact_gate: Trigger4 repairs and regression-proves canonical Piper runtime identity, then exactly one fresh repaired-subject S2 PipeWire G2 execution/readback may be dispatched if singleton ownership is clear.
